incident_text: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed. Dust covers the street and neighbours say some residents may still be inside.

result.scene_summary: A multi-storey building is partially collapsed with debris scattered on the ground, surrounded by other structures and vegetation.

observations.description: A building with multiple floors is heavily damaged, with roof and upper levels collapsed and exposed interiors.
No visible standing water or flooding.
A street lamp pole and some intact buildings are visible in the background.
Trees and shrubs are visible near the debris.
A large white sack is on a concrete base in the foreground.

inconsistencies: Report mentions dust covering the street, but the street appears clear in the image.
not_determinable: Structural integrity of the building's remaining sections
Scale or distance to other buildings
